name: Recorder
about: Record from any input — phone mic, headset, Bluetooth, USB, lavaliers, screen audio; processing modes for music, speech, singing and broadcast
dev.speaker: Phone speaker
lavHint: A lavalier or wireless system. Its noise cancellation, gain and modes are set on the receiver or in the maker’s app (Hollyland LarkSound, DJI Mimo) — their protocols are closed. To avoid double processing, keep noise reduction off here if it is on at the receiver.
btHint: A Bluetooth headset records over the voice channel: lower quality (16 kHz), like a phone call. For music, a wired, USB mic or a lavalier with a USB receiver is better.
rawHint: Clean sound without system noise suppression and auto gain — for music
devHint: Connected headphones, Bluetooth, USB mics and lavalier receivers appear in the list automatically. The input is chosen before recording, the output for listening.
devHintWeb: In the browser, device names appear after mic permission; output selection isn’t in every browser. Full input and output choice is in the Android app.
fxHint: The source never changes: “Processed” — listen to the result, “Save” — to the library.
discardText: It hasn’t been saved to the media library and will be lost.
micDenied: No microphone access. It can be allowed in the phone settings.
micNone: The microphone is unavailable — another app may be using it.
micMissing: No microphone found — no input is connected.
m.clipAria: Clip: lights when the level hit the threshold. Tap to reset
m.hint: For music, keep peaks around −12…−6 dBFS: headroom before clipping, and normalization will raise the loudness. The CLIP light blinks when the level reached the threshold; “∞” keeps it lit until tapped.
help.1: Input — phone, headset, Bluetooth, USB, screen audio.
help.2: The processing mode is heard before recording; afterwards — trim and compare with the source.
help.3: The source is kept separately and never lost: a crash or a disconnected input keeps the recording.
help.tip: Denoise needs a second of silence at the start.
live.title: Sound before recording
live.off: The input is not being listened to — tap the wave above.
live.hint: Mode and effects sound right away (in headphones — the headphones icon). The source goes to the file; saving applies the same chain plus noise reduction and file loudness.
kept.title: Recordings in recorder memory
kept.hint: Recording sources: unsaved and cut-off ones are never deleted automatically; open to listen, process and save.
noSpace: Low storage — recording did not start. Free at least 50 MB.
noAudio: No audio selected: tick “Share tab audio” or “System audio” in the picker.
procFailText: The recording is intact. Save the unprocessed source?
mode.title: Processing mode
modeh.raw: No processing: the file holds exactly what came in.
modeh.music: Uncoloured: rumble removed, peaks limited, loudness −16 LUFS.
modeh.speech: Clear: low cut, quieter pauses, no sibilance, even loudness.
modeh.vocal: Singing: gentle compression, air on top, no sibilance, −14 LUFS.
modeh.radio: Radio chain: low cut, expander, de-esser, tone, dense compression, limiter.
modeh.band: Loud rehearsal on a phone: slow gentle compression glues, the limiter catches peaks.
vs.title: Processing settings
keepRawHint: An untouched copy next to the processed one
vsh.hp: Removes rumble, wind and stand knocks. Voice — 80–100 Hz, instruments — 30–40.
vsh.exp: Below the threshold — quieter still: cleaner pauses, softer than a gate. Set just above the noise in pauses.
vsh.ds: Tames “s” and “sh” only while they sound and only in the highs.
vsh.tone: Body — lows and proximity, mud — boxiness, clarity — words, air — sheen.
vsh.comp: Brings quiet and loud closer. Attack — how fast it catches, release — how fast it lets go.
vsh.lim: Nothing goes above the ceiling — no clipping in the file.
vsh.level: EBU R128: −14 — streaming, −16 — podcasts and Apple, −19 — quieter, −23 — broadcast. The limiter never squeezes more than 6 dB for a target. File only.
vsh.dn: Learns the noise from the quietest parts. File only; needs a second of silence.
kept.saved: in the library — source kept for 14 days
kept.cut: recording was cut off — open and save
lost.switch: Input disconnected — recording continues from the built-in mic
lost.stop: Input disconnected — recording stopped, everything recorded is kept
lost.space: Storage is running out — recording stopped, everything recorded is kept
